description: Having trouble waking up in the morning? Then You are not using Alarmy, the highest-rated alarm clock app in the world, with 4.8 stars from over 430K reviews ! THE ALARM CLOCK THAT MAKES YOUR "BODY" WAKE UP Alarmy makes your BODY get out of bed first and then makes you get to the place like a bathroom where you have no other choices but to wake up. Alarm will keep ringing until you prove the fact that you arrived at the place through taking a "Photo" or scanning a "Barcode". You may take other missions which won't make you move to the specific place but just do a short exercise like "Squat" or "Stepping". Whichever you choose you will get to know that your body has already woken up within 1 minute ! THE ALARM CLOCK THAT MAKES YOUR "BRAIN" WAKE UP For those who feel uncomfortable to move their body from the early in the morning, Alarmy can also make your BRAIN wake up instead of body. Alarm will keep ringing until you solve several math problems or you clear the memory test game. You may choose another mission like "Typing" that stimulates different parts of brain. While typing some motivational phrases or your own self-motivating phrases, your will to wake up gets stronger ! TO WAKE YOUR BODY UP ■ [Free] Photo Mission - Wake up and take a photo of the registered place to dismiss your alarm. Somewhere far from bed such as bathroom sink, front door is recommended! ■ [Free] Barcode Mission - Scan the barcode or QR code you registered to turn the alarm off. Something in bathroom or kitchen is recommended ! ■ [Free] Shake Mission - Shake your phone up to 999 times to wake up your body ■ [Premium] Squat Mission - Take several rounds of squats as you get up. You'll get to know your body is getting much healthier ■ [Premium] Step Mission - Get out of bed and take 10 or 20 or 50 steps to get moving right away TO WAKE YOUR BRAIN UP ■ [Free] Math Mission - Solve simple or advanced math problems and kickstart your brain ■ [Free] Memory Mission - Energize your brain by memorizing which tiles are open ■ [Premium] Typing Mission - Type a few motivational quotations into your keyboard to energize yourself as you get up OTHER STRONG FEATURES ■ [Free] Use Snooze / Gradually increase volume / Vibrate features to make your awakening gentle ■ [Free] Quick Alarm for quick tasks when you don't have time with minimal settings ■ [Premium]Wake Up Check - If you worry you might fall back asleep, worry no more. Wake Up Check will check on you until you prove you’re fully awake ■ [Premium] Backup Sound - Sometimes your alarm just doesn’t get you up. But if you wait for too long, you get a second, very LOUD alarm Alarmy is officially a free app, providing numerous attractive waking-up features for free ! Just for those who would like to enjoy an unlimited successful morning experience with premium features, 7-day Free Trial is provided. Of course you can just enjoy free features of Alarmy, which is still strong & effective ! PERMISSION INFO CAMERA - This app needs this permission for the photo mission, which requires users to take a photo WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE - This app needs this permission to load external ringtones READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE - This app needs this permission to save pictures taken by users who are using the photo mission ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION - This app needs this permission if you want to get weather information in Today’s panel. BIND_DEVICE_ADMIN - This app needs this permission if you want to use prevent yourself from uninstalling it - It uses DEVICE MANAGER permission SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW - This app needs this permission to display dismiss screen on Android 10 or higher versions Alarmy uses the Accessibility Service API to provide the ‘Prevent turn off’ feature, which blocks turning the device off while the alarm is ringing.
